summary: Tested Phase 2 Custom Roles + RBAC. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass — Accountant /auth/me perms exactly {dashboard:[view], ledger:[view], receipts:[view,create], invoices:[view]}; GET /ledger, /receipts = 200 and GET /sales, /parties, /users, POST /sales all return 403; owner has full access; /api/roles CRUD (create, list, edit, delete) works; delete of a role assigned to a staff member is properly blocked (>=400); Accountant is denied /api/roles. Frontend: Accountant sidebar correctly limited to Dashboard/Party Ledger/Payments & Receipts/Invoices; direct nav to /admin/sales and /admin/users both render the access-restricted screen; Receipts page shows the 'Add New' button (has create perm); Owner sees all 23 nav items; Roles page create-role flow works, including auto-tick of 'view' when ticking a non-view op (sales-create -> sales-view auto-checked, confirmed data-state=checked); new custom role appears in the Users role dropdown with 'Operator', 'Admin', 'Accountant', and the new TEST_QA_* role visible.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Add Entry' button is visible to a custom-role user who only has ledger:view (Accountant). Spec requires 'on any screen where they only have view the Add/Edit/Delete buttons are hidden'. Backend correctly returns 403 if clicked, but the button should be hidden. Ledger.jsx renders the add button unconditionally (no useAuth/perms gating like CrudPage has).

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` on DialogContent (a11y warning, non-blocking)

action_items: Gate Ledger.jsx 'Add Entry' button (and its per-row delete trash icon if present) on perms.ledger.includes('create'/'delete') using useAuth(), same pattern as CrudPage. Audit other non-CrudPage screens (Invoices, Reports, Credit/Debit Notes special actions) for the same missing UI gating; backend enforcement is already correct.
critical_code_review_comments: Roles.jsx and Users.jsx look clean; permission matrix builder correctly auto-adds 'view' when a non-view op is ticked and clears the row when 'view' is untoggled.
Backend compute_perms filters custom-role permissions against ALL_FEATURES whitelist — good deny-by-default posture.
Ledger.jsx does not import useAuth and unconditionally shows the 'Add Entry' button — inconsistent with the perms-gated pattern in CrudPage.jsx.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (1 UI gating miss on Ledger add button)
